handoff: Review approve: unit guard meets AC1-AC4 (self-test 8 pass, AC4 re-run by hand with --preload: '(fail) reads the head' + message, pure test passes), not in root bunfig, typecheck green. Two non-blocking notes: Bun.main fallback for file name off-stack, async spawn after test end attributed to next test.

findings.title: Test file falls back to Bun.main when no .test. frame is on the stack
findings.detail:
testFile() reads the file from the synchronous stack. When a spawn runs from a timer or a callback that no longer has the test file on its stack, the message names Bun.main (relative to the repo root), which may not be the offending file. bun's (fail) line still names the test, so the failure is still found.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: when the stack has no .test. frame, say 'unknown test file' instead of a path that may be wrong.

findings.title: A spawn after a test ends is reported against the next test
findings.detail:
pending carries over until the next afterEach, so a fire-and-forget spawn that runs after its test finished fails the following test. This is rare in unit tests and the message still names the right file.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None needed now; reconsider if slice 07's sorting shows misattributed failures.
